title: jmap-quotas-types: RFC 9425 Quota, Scope, ResourceType, filter, comparator, capability
description: New crate crate-jmap-quotas-types (extension-types family, mirror jmap-mail-types / jmap-sharing-types idioms): JMAP_QUOTA_URI = urn:ietf:params:jmap:quota; QuotaCapability {} (Session and account, RFC 9425 §2.1); Scope and ResourceType via impl_string_enum! (§3.1, §3.2); Quota { id, resourceType, used, hardLimit, scope, name, types, warnLimit?, softLimit?, description?, extra } (§4.1); QuotaFilterCondition { name, scope, resourceType, type } (§4.4) with deny_unknown_fields like siblings; QuotaComparator over name/used (§4.4 MUST); JmapObject/GetObject/QueryObject impls (no SetObject: Quota is read-only). Tests: RFC 9425 §5.1 example round-trip (note the example's 'Mail'/'Calendar'/'Contact' type names), enum unknown-value round-trip, BTreeMap order test. Workspace member, workspace.dependencies entry, public-api snapshot.
